entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The spec addresses one user-defined concern: validating required flow artifacts before flow-level gate-impl accepts implementation fulfillment.; Task Single Responsibility — Each task has a single shared concern: validator creation, gate wiring, placeholder guidance, or regression tests.; Unambiguous Requirements — The requirements use concrete artifact names, phases, failure codes, paths, and conditions rather than vague adjectives.; Complete Context — The requirements define enough concrete artifact paths, JSON fields, phases, and pass/fail conditions for reviewers to evaluate implementation satisfaction.; REQ Diff-Verifiability — The requirements are framed around files, JSON fields, failure codes, and tests that can be checked from a unified diff and test execution summary.; No Hardcoded Secrets — The content does not include source code or any hardcoded API keys, passwords, tokens, or other secrets.; No Silent Error Swallowing — The content does not include source code with catch blocks or error-discarding behavior.; Prioritize Requirements — There are more than three requirements, and each requirement includes priority "must".; Impact on Existing Features — The spec lists impacts on existing behavior, including preserving existing validation, excluding task-level gate-impl, and excluding downstream retro/report artifacts.; Bounded Resource Usage — flow-level gate-impl (phase=integration) shall reject known placeholder artifacts when configured placeholder sentinel strings appear in test-execute-result.json summary[].evidence.command, summary[].evidence.test_name, summary[].evidence.test_file, regression.command, regression.root_test_command, or test-result-review.json checked_items[].detail, or when a JSON artifact hash matches a documented placeholder fixture hash used by tests; file-map.json path values and tests/.raw/test-execution.log are not globally sentinel-scanned. — The requirement introduces sentinel scanning over repeated JSON arrays but does not state explicit upper bounds for count or size. (at requirements[2].desc); Spec Includes Test Strategy — The spec includes test strategy details in each task and requirement R6 defines required automated test coverage.; Record Unresolved Points as Open Questions — The Open Questions section is present and empty, so the content does not present unresolved points as fabricated answers.; Include 'Why This Approach' Rationale — The alternatives_considered section and background explain why the selected artifact-validation approach was chosen.; Spec Test Coverage — This cannot be evaluated from the provided spec content alone because it requires implementation diff or filesystem evidence that test files exist under specs/<specid>/tests/ with // spec: headers.; Backward-Compatible CLI Interface — The spec does not remove or change the meaning of existing CLI commands or options.; Exit Code Contract — The content does not add or modify a CLI command; it modifies flow-level gate behavior and failure envelopes.; Validate User Input at Entry Point — The content does not add or modify user-facing CLI command arguments.

entries.reason: R1 — spec.json lists the four required integration trust inputs and explicitly excludes task-level gate-impl, retro.json, and report.json; contract code only requires inputs for gate-impl phase=integration.; R2 — Integration gate now prevalidates required artifacts and returns ARTIFACT_PLACEHOLDER before guardrail evaluation for missing/malformed artifacts, schema/key failures, empty or unknown requirement summaries, raw line range errors, and raw evidence mismatches.; R3 — Sentinel scanning is present on the required JSON paths with 200-entry and 1 MiB budgets, and file-map/raw log are not globally scanned, but configured sentinels are converted to regexes with word boundaries and a broken escapeRegExp replacement, so arbitrary configured sentinel strings may not be rejected when they appear.; R4 — Integration gate still validates test-execute-result.json version 2, requires test-result-review verdict pass via assertIntegrationRegressionEvidence, enforces spec-local evidence paths under spec tests, and preserves regression snapshot freshness checks.; R5 — Flow guidance now requires explicit user permission for placeholders, and gate validation requires specs/<spec>/placeholder-permission.json with version 1, integration phase, approvedByUser true, covering artifactPaths, and non-empty permissionText/reason/createdAt before tolerating detected placeholder artifacts.; R6 — Added automated tests under specs/258-gate-artifact-validation/tests with a spec header and coverage for valid, missing, malformed, sentinel, unknown file-map requirement, and explicit-permission scenarios.
